tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build (dev Profile)
tasks.detail: Builds the Peripherals_Test_Suite project using the 'dev' profile into build_dev/.

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build (prod Profile)
tasks.detail: Builds the Peripherals_Test_Suite project using the 'prod' profile into build_prod/.

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build (ci Profile)
tasks.detail: Builds the Peripherals_Test_Suite project using the 'ci' profile for automated testing into build_ci/.

tasks.label: esptool: Flash (dev Profile)
tasks.command: . 'C:\Espressif\tools\Microsoft.v6.1.PowerShell_profile.ps1'; Set-Location build_dev; $p = if ($env:ESPPORT) { @('-p', $env:ESPPORT) } else { @() }; python -m esptool @p -b 460800 --before default-reset --after hard-reset write-flash '@flash_args'
tasks.detail: Flashes the 'dev' build using python -m esptool write-flash. Reads '@flash_args' with kebab-case reset modes.

tasks.label: esptool: Flash (prod Profile)
tasks.command: . 'C:\Espressif\tools\Microsoft.v6.1.PowerShell_profile.ps1'; Set-Location build_prod; $p = if ($env:ESPPORT) { @('-p', $env:ESPPORT) } else { @() }; python -m esptool @p -b 460800 --before default-reset --after hard-reset write-flash '@flash_args'
tasks.detail: Flashes the 'prod' build using python -m esptool write-flash. Reads '@flash_args' with kebab-case reset modes.

tasks.label: esptool: Erase Flash
tasks.detail: Erases the entire target flash memory using python -m esptool erase-flash.

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Monitor Serial Console
tasks.detail: Opens the serial monitor for the connected target board.

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Clean All Profile Build Directories
tasks.command: . 'C:\Espressif\tools\Microsoft.v6.1.PowerShell_profile.ps1'; if (Test-Path build_dev) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build_dev }; if (Test-Path build_prod) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build_prod }; if (Test-Path build_ci) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build_ci }; Get-ChildItem -Filter sdkconfig.* | Where-Object { $_.Name -notlike 'sdkconfig.defaults*' } | Remove-Item -Force
tasks.detail: Removes all profile build output directories (build_dev, build_prod, build_ci) and generated sdkconfig files.
